project_info.theme: Minimal luxury fashion cover in a sculpted red dress

main_subject.detail: Clearly adult woman with dark voluminous hair, calm direct gaze and a soft confident smile. She stands centered with a subtle hip shift and hands lightly at the waist, wearing a sculpted strapless red mini dress with an asymmetric hem, coordinated red hosiery and red heels.

composition_elements.layout: vertical full-body magazine cover with the model centered and balanced negative space
items: large fashion masthead and cover line
composition_elements.text: Use a fictional fashion-cover masthead and neutral cover copy; do not reproduce the supplied real-person name.

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: soft cinematic studio lighting with gentle shadow contours
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: clean elegant red silhouette, realistic skin texture and refined magazine-cover polish

technical_specs.optics: portrait lens, shallow depth of field, ultra-sharp subject and gentle studio bokeh

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-photorealistic fashion magazine cover portrait of a generic clearly adult woman standing center frame with a subtle hip shift, arms elegantly bent and hands lightly at the waist, head slightly tilted forward, a calm direct gaze and a soft natural confident smile. She has dark hair with natural volume and wears a sculpted strapless red mini dress with an asymmetric hem, matching red hosiery and red heels. Use realistic skin texture, cinematic studio lighting creating gentle shadow contours, a minimalist warm-beige luxury interior, shallow depth of field and 8K detail. Compose a polished vertical fashion-cover layout with a fictional masthead and neutral editorial copy. Preserve the source red dress, pose, hosiery, heels, lighting and minimal luxury concept without reproducing Ana de Armas or any public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, misspelled text, recognizable logo, distorted hem
